title: Chapter 604
paragraphs: Chapter 604
Episode 156. Purification of Chaos (8)
Boras was burning with research passion with the continuous new discoveries.
"If Tushin fusion occurs through Chaos, then the ancestral brothers, Nana and Kaka, may also be related to the first Chaos. This is a historical discovery!"
As soon as Ban turned his gaze to Boras, Chaos laughed at Jin.
Jin couldn't help but be irritated.
'Wow... I'm so pissed off.'
He felt his insides boiling. As Jin approached, Chaos showed his teeth and stepped back.
"Hey, you can speak, right?"
[Kingking?]
"You understand well, you're quick-witted. I see no reason you can't use language. Explain right now, why are you affecting the Tushin fusion."
Chaos just shook his head as if he didn't understand what he meant.
"That would also be due to Tushin blood, Brother Jin."
"Brother Boras."

"As I said earlier, your Tushin blood underwent a kind of transformation, or evolution, resisting Chaos during the battle with Gleek. And what changed then was not only Tushin blood... but that Chaos. It must have been influenced by the Tushin blood."
Tushin blood and Chaos.
Boras judged that the two had changed each other's properties while they were intertwined in Jin's body.
Just as Tushin blood resisted Chaos, Chaos also collided with Tushin blood, creating a kind of connection between the two.
"Originally, the two powers tried to mix inside you but failed. It ended with neither side completely eroding the other."
However, the fight had turned into a judgment victory for Chaos. If Jin hadn't come to Lapra Rosa, he would have met destruction within a month due to the hidden Chaos.

"In other words, both Tushin blood and Chaos were in a transformed state, having partially accepted each other's properties. But now, with an entity nearby that can react to both energies at the same time, Tushin fusion is naturally forming!"
Tushin Ban, the energy she has is compatible with both damaged Chaos and Tushin blood...
Boras was inferring the current situation in that way.
"As expected, I'm a genius. To come up with these thoughts in an instant."
"Brother Otuwang is indeed smart."
"... If it's as Brother Otuwang says, it does explain to some extent. The reason why Tushin fusion only unfolds when he and the Tushin brothers are close."
The only related case is Nana and Kaka, but there are no detailed records, and therefore, Tushin fusion is a legendary martial art without even a theory left.
So all they could do was infer and experiment.
"Brothers. Take the Chaos away again."
At Bora's words, Baltirok and Lumora once again took Chaos out of the training ground.
As expected, Jin and Ban felt the resonance dissipating as Chaos moved away. Each time they brought it back to the training ground, the resonance began again.
The same phenomenon occurred not just in the central training ground. They wandered all over Laprarosa, repeating the same experiment, but the result was always the same.
"This confirms it..."
Bora unfolded a note briefly documenting the experimental process and results.

"About 1 Li. Regardless of location, if the distance between the brothers and Chaos exceeds that, no fusion of divinity occurs. To achieve fusion of divinity, the three must be within 1 Li of each other."
During the experiment, Ban questioned if 'distance doesn't matter, and if Chaos can control the fusion of divinity as it pleases?'

That question was resolved through a series of experiments where Chaos was blindfolded, its other senses were blocked as much as possible, and Jin and Ban spent a long time adjusting the distance between them.
The conclusion was that Chaos did not have the ability to control the fusion of divinity. The key was simply the distance.
Bora concluded that the reason the fusion of divinity did not occur in the first battle with Chaos was 'because it took time for Chaos, the divinity blood, and Ban's energy to synchronize'.
During the experiment, Chaos began to behave more arrogantly. It acted as if, without it, they couldn't perform the fusion of divinity...
"Brother Jin."
"Yes, Brother Bora."
"Upon reflection, our goal was to purify the chaos in you and recover your power, not to acquire an unexpected legendary martial art."
"That's right."
"So let's end the experiments on fusion
of divinity here. Let's focus on finishing off that creature."
"I agree, Brother Bora."
Although Bora was a bit disappointed that this legendary discovery was ending this way, he did not oppose the decision of Ban and Jin.

"Well, it's a shame as a blacksmith and a researcher, but it can't be helped. But you never know. After handling Chaos, the fact that Jin's divinity blood has changed is established, so we might still be able to find a way to achieve the fusion of divinity."
"Thankfully, it was a fascinating experience, so the time was not wasted. What will you do, Brother Jin? Will you start fighting with it again from today? Or do you need a rest?"
At this point, Chaos had no choice but to turn pale. The situation was developing completely differently from what Chaos had hoped for.
"We will start immediately."
They could keep using the fusion of divinity until they finished off Chaos anyway. After all, the fusion of divinity automatically manifested as long as the three were within 1 Li of each other.
Buzz!
Ban's energy began to flow into Jin's heart. Having already recovered 10% of his strength, Jin was much stronger than in previous battles.
As the fight was about to start, Chaos seemed to be in a bind, looking around.
However, there was no one to stop the fight, and no place to run away. All Chaos could do was to fight back.
This time, Ban prepared to protect Jin by keeping a distance of five steps, so it was no problem if Jin fainted from the overload of the fusion, as before.
For Chaos, it was an impossible fight to win.
Clink-!
Naturally, the one who rushed in first was Jin.
The Brada Mante, stained with spirit energy and aura, was now regaining its former power. Thanks to the addition of Ban's energy to the 10% of aura he had recovered.
Chaos couldn't counterattack recklessly under Ban's momentum. He kept forming protective shields and retreating.
'It feels like I've somehow become a villain.'
Fortunately, he could shake off such an uncomfortable feeling before long.
There is a link between Jin and Chaos that connects their inner selves. Through this, Jin was certain that Chaos was really 'pretending to be pitiful'.
Chaos's true intention was that he was annoyed because his plan went awry.
'Damn human, you're nothing on your own, but you're messing with me by carrying monsters on your back?'
The moment the voice of Chaos's heart reached him, Jin opened his eyes wide and locked eyes with him.
The other brothers couldn't hear it.
'Are you saying I'm nothing on my own? You, who stole all my power, think like that?'
It was a series of absurdities for Jin, and a series of annoyances for Chaos.

'Well, it would have been nice if we each lived our own lives peacefully! If you come out like this, I have a thought, too. There will be no more mercy. But it's a pity to just finish you off, so first, take a hit! My powerful front paw swing.'
If Chaos's thoughts had not been conveyed.
Jin would not have been able to avoid Chaos's front paw attack that followed in the next moment. It was a speed that Jin, even with 10% of his aura and the fusion, could not react to.
'Huh, how did he dodge it!?'
'He really attacks as he thinks......'
'Is it luck? No, he dodged again!?'

Jin not only managed to dodge, but he also succeeded in penetrating his side. He managed to capture the 10% of power that had been stored in his flank before he reflexively pulled his body out of shock.
'Damn! He stole my power again... Ugh!'
Brada Mante hit him on the forehead.
He didn't have enough strength to cut, but a dull impact sounded.
"Why is that your power, huh!?"
While Chaos was writhing in pain, Jin once again thrust his sword into Chaos's abdomen with all his might.
[Kyaaaak!]
In that moment, Jin reclaimed another 10% of his aura that had been tied up in Chaos's abdomen.
"Oh, the energy of Brother Jin is getting bigger and bigger!"
"But didn't Brother Jin seem to say something to that guy just now?"
"Did he? Anyway, at this rate, he'll recover all of it soon, right?"
The observers from the Demon King tribe were correct. Already today, he had recovered 20% of his aura and 10% of his magical power.
'I understand how Murakan felt. When I lost my power, it felt like the world had disappeared, but it's so refreshing to start getting it back. And, apparently, unlike me, he can't read my thoughts.'
He didn't know why there was such a difference, and it wasn't particularly important.
'The important thing is, what's his next move?'
It was only a few minutes ago that Chaos thought he had a secret weapon against him.
Chaos intended to use that method after venting his anger on Jin as long as possible, but the situation was unfavorable, so he had to use it right away.
'Well, now you won't be able to get help from those monsters either.'
Chaos spread his wings.
Jin tried to jump and attack, but he stopped his movements as he saw Chaos's body suddenly disintegrate into particles.
He was changing form.
'Transformation?'
Ban showed anger at Chaos's sudden action, but there was nothing she could do to stop it. She couldn't inflict direct damage on Chaos.
Instead, as soon as Chaos's form began to disperse, Jin was able to additionally acquire the energy of his that remained in the void momentarily.
Chaos didn't show any other thoughts as if he had accepted that much damage.
Precisely, Chaos's inner thoughts were no longer being conveyed to Jin. As soon as Chaos changed his form, the sound of his heart that had naturally been conveyed was completely cut off.

It didn't take long for Chaos's transformation to complete. About ten seconds later, Jin and the Demon Kings could only tilt their heads in confusion as they confirmed the transformed appearance of Chaos.
"That is......"
"A door? Is it a door?"
A door.
The form that Chaos transformed into was a door, similar to what Dante had seen when he was trapped in the white stone in the past.
